visa.notes: Lowest income threshold in EU. A2 Portuguese for permanent residency after 5 years.

rent.notes: Lisbon municipality asking rents 20.35 EUR/m2/month (Aug 2026 observatory) and 23.2 EUR/m2 (MVGM Q1 2026); an 80-90 m2 pet-friendly T2/small moradia implies ~1,700-2,000. Min reflects outer parishes/Loures-Amadora side, max central or house with garden. Asking rents fell 2-4% y/y in early 2026 after years of gains.

electricity.notes: EDP/Endesa. Moderate A/C in summer (Lisbon 85°F). Electric heating in winter. 6% IVA on first 150kWh, 23% above.

gas.notes: Galp/EDP. Natural gas or butano for cooking/water heater. Mild winters, less heating.

water.notes: EPAL (Lisbon) / municipal. Includes saneamento (sewage) and resíduos (waste) as line items. 6% IVA.

sewage.notes: Included in water bill as saneamento.

trash.notes: Included in water bill as taxa de resíduos sólidos.

utilities.taxes: IVA: 6% on electricity (≤150kWh), 23% above; 6% on water; 23% on gas. All included in bills.
utilities.notes: Electricity ~80 for a 2BR moradia with summer A/C and electric heating (regulated-market couple benchmark 37.77/month at 1,900 kWh after the Oct 2026 +2.7%; ERSE proposes +1.5% for Jan 2027), gas ~30 (unverified estimate), EPAL water incl. saneamento and residuos ~35 (EPAL +0.17/month in 2026 at 7 m3; ERSAR national 10 m3 average 34.65). Numbeo Lisbon basic utilities 85 m2: 136.74 (Nov 2026). Excludes internet.

healthcare.notes: Legal residents register with the SNS at no premium (primary care free since 2022). Private top-up cover that expat retirees typically carry: a couple in their 60s on standard Medis/Multicare/Fidelidade plans pays about 250-350 EUR/month total (Sep 2026 guide); hospital-only plans for two around 120; premium tiers 180-280 per person. Pre-existing condition loading can push toward max. Premiums rose ~10% in 2026.

transportation.notes: Transit-based as stored: two Navegante Metropolitano passes at 40 EUR each (price frozen for 2026, seventh year); Navegante +65 drops to 20 EUR each at 65. Max covers occasional taxi/ride-hail or car rental; min is one pass plus pay-as-you-go.
